subject: Re: Confidential — Private VPC deployment: commit ladder, platform fee, and acceptance
messages:
From: Dave Lemaire <dave.lemaire@acmecloud.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 08:03:00 -0500
Subject: Private VPC — initial MAP and commercial asks

Olga,

Thanks for taking the call this morning. As discussed, Acme Cloud is evaluating a fully private VPC deployment for our AI inference workloads (sensitive customer PII). We need a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that ties evaluation checkpoints to commercial milestones — specifically: a pilot acceptance, an org-wide nonce commit (GPU hours / monthly), and pricing triggers for platform fee reductions as we ramp.

High level asks from procurement:
- A 6–8 week evaluation path with clear acceptance criteria for security and performance (SOC2 evidence and network architecture review).
- Pricing ladder: pilot price -> ramp price -> committed rate at scale (with discrete discount thresholds at 50% and 80% of target commit).
- Platform fee discussion: can Redwood provide a time-boxed waiver or stepped-down platform fee tied to commit milestones?

Attached: our procurement checklist and an internal target timeline (Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx).

Can you share a draft MAP and a proposed commercial structure by end of week?

—Dave
Procurement Manager, Acme Cloud
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Dave Lemaire <dave.lemaire@acmecloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 12:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Private VPC — initial MAP and commercial asks

Dave — thanks for the clear summary and the spreadsheet. I’ve put together a first-pass MAP and commercial proposal that aligns milestones to pricing/fee adjustments. Quick summary below; I’ve attached the draft SOW and a MAP workbook for your review.

Summary (high level):
1) Pilot phase (6 weeks):
   - Goal: validate infra/hardening, run 3 production-like jobs and 10k inference/day load profile
   - Acceptance: SOC2 evidence review complete; latency percentile targets met; runbook and Ops handoff documented
   - Commercial: pilot pricing at $X/token (listed in attached sheet) — one-time pilot platform fee waived if we meet pilot acceptance in 6 weeks

2) Ramp (months 2–6):
   - Goal: ramp to 50% of target commit (measured in reserved GPU hours/month)
   - Discount trigger: once 50% commit reached, platform fee steps down by 30% for next three months

3) Commit tier (month 6+):
   - If Acme commits to the agreed reserved capacity (annualized), we apply a further platform fee reduction and an embedded unit-token discount (details in workbook)

Open items:
- Platform fee runway: we can do a phased reduction but would need a minimum annual commitment to reach the deepest discount.
- Legal: standard Redwood Private license with data controls; need to nail indemnities and export controls — I will loop in legal.

Next steps: I’ll coordinate internally to firm up the numbers (platform fee ladder and concrete $ figures) and send an updated MAP + SOW by Friday. If that works, can we get a proposed signature target in week of Feb 2?

Attachments: SOW_Acme_vpc_draft.pdf, Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jan 2026 09:34:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Private VPC — initial MAP and commercial asks — Need final pricing & platform fee approach

Team — forwarding Acme’s asks and my draft MAP. They want a pilot acceptance -> ramp -> commit ladder with platform fee step-downs tied to 50% and 100% commit triggers. Key constraints: they want SOC2 evidence and a VPC on day 1.

Questions for pricing/legal/finance:
- Marissa: can we accept the proposed 30% temporary platform fee reduction at 50% ramp, and what’s the minimum annual dollar commitment we’d require to go to the deepest discount?
- Karthik: what legal concessions on indemnity/export controls do we allow for an on-prem + private control plane deployment? Any redlines we should pre-clear with procurement?
- Aditya: verify economics — if we waive a pilot platform fee conditionally, what is the NPV impact across the first 12 months under the proposed ladder? Need a simple sensitivity (attached sheet has target commit).

I’d like answers by EOD Thu so I can incorporate and send the commercial terms back to Dave on Friday.

Attachments: Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOW_Acme_vpc_draft.pdf

—Olga
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Dave Lemaire <dave.lemaire@acmecloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 26 Jan 2026 14:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Private VPC — MAP & commercial proposal (updated)

Dave — thanks for the patience. Attached is an updated MAP and the redline SOW (SOW_Acme_vpc_draft.pdf) reflecting internal alignment. Highlights:

- Pilot (weeks 0–6): pilot platform fee waived on successful acceptance (acceptance criteria enumerated in MAP workbook). Pilot pricing rates remain unchanged.
- Ramp (months 2–6): upon reaching 50% of the agreed reserved GPU hours/month, Redwood will reduce the platform fee by 25% (pilot-tested accounts get a prorated credit). The step-down is effective for a 3-month window to accelerate volume testing.
- Commit tier (month 6+): with a signed annual reserved commit (deal_id ACME-2026-PLAT-01), we’ll apply a further 20% platform fee reduction plus a 10% unit-token discount; these are contingent on a minimum annual dollar commitment of $1.2M.
- Security/compliance: we attached a one-page SOC2 summary and proposed evidence checklist; legal has pre-cleared standard indemnities for VPC-only deployments with limited export control exceptions.

Attached: SOW_Acme_vpc_draft.pdf, Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOC2_Summary.pdf

Next steps: if this aligns, please confirm the pilot start date (we propose Feb 9) and we will upload the final SOW to DocuSign. I’ve also added a tentative signature target for week of Feb 16.

DocuSign link (for convenience): https://www.docusign.com/link/abcdef123456

Looking forward — happy to jump on a 30-min sync this week to walk through the MAP.

Best regards,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOW_Acme_vpc_draft.pdf (draft SOW), Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan workbook), SOC2_Summary.pdf (evidence summary)
